title: PlayStation 3 turns 20 (North America 17 Nov 2006; Japan 11 Nov 2006)
status: bank piece ready (v2 rendered 8 Nov 2026, director PASS), for Tue 17 Nov 2026 (NA launch anniversary)
lane: Digital Lounge only (X, Instagram, Threads); evergreen bank, dated 17 Nov 2026 (Japan's 20th is Wed 11 Nov 2026, six days earlier)
beat: anniversary: PS3 went on sale in North America on 17 Nov 2006 at $499 (20 GB) and $599 (60 GB), six days after Japan (11 Nov); Resistance: Fall of Man a launch title; Sony says over 87 million sold. Date chosen: 17 Nov because Sony's own post-launch release (SCEA, 17 Nov 2006) confirms the sale and the prices; Japan's date rests on Sony's pre-launch releases and the PlayStation history page.
first_report: Sony Computer Entertainment America press release, Foster City, 17 Nov 2006 ('PlayStation 3 Launches Next Generation of Entertainment in North America'); PlayStation.com history page (2007-ps3-ps-vita). Not news: an anniversary dated by the day itself.

sources.what: 'Sales of PS3 began early this morning across the country'; $499 20 GB, $599 60 GB; Resistance: Fall of Man, NBA 07, Genji: Days of the Blade among SCEA titles; more than 20 titles
Japanese release 11 Nov 2006, North American release 17 Nov 2006, European release 23 Mar 2007; 'went on to sell over 87,000,000 consoles'
'will be available in North America on November 17, 2006'; launch lineup names

sources.who: SCEI releases 8 May, 22 Sep and 3 Oct 2006 (hosted by Sony Interactive)
sources.what: Japan launch 11 Nov 2006 (Saturday); Japan 20 GB price changed from 59,800 yen to 49,980 yen on 22 Sep 2006, so the Reel gives no Japan price

claims.claim: PS3 on sale in North America from 17 Nov 2006

claims.status: confirmed (PlayStation history page; SCEI pre-launch releases)

claims.claim: Resistance: Fall of Man a launch title
claims.status: confirmed (SCEA release of the day names it among SCEA titles)
confirmed as Sony's own statement (PlayStation history page); the Reel says 'according to PlayStation's site'
NOT used: SCEI's May 2006 release said 17 Nov for Europe, but the history page gives 23 Mar 2007

footage: stills: official PlayStation.com images (the PlayStation history page and the 30th-anniversary wallpaper: console, red advert, Resistance: Fall of Man box art, XrossMediaBar). Footage sources tried: PlayStation.com's PS3 start-up clip (10.9 s, 1080p, the PS3 start-up sound, but the picture is a TV on a white ground: a 9:16 crop would enlarge it about 3x and cut the logo; the showcase layout is not built in reel.py), Steam (no PS3 titles), PS3-era game trailers (only on YouTube, not fetchable), SIE press images (spec tables only).

drafts.instagram:
صدرت PlayStation 3 قبل 20 عامًا في أمريكا الشمالية.

بدأ بيع الجهاز صباح 17 نوفمبر 2006 بسعر 499 دولارًا لنسخة 20 غيغابايت و599 دولارًا لنسخة 60 غيغابايت، بعد ستة أيام من إطلاقه في اليابان يوم 11 نوفمبر، وفق بيانات سوني (Sony).

وكانت Resistance: Fall of Man وNBA 07 وGenji: Days of the Blade من ألعاب الإطلاق التي أعلنتها سوني. ووفق موقع بلايستيشن (PlayStation)، تجاوزت مبيعات الجهاز 87 مليون جهاز.

الصور من موقع بلايستيشن.

#ألعاب #أخبار_الألعاب #PlayStation3 #PS3
